text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ""Thank you for waving the safety flag when we were walking home from school," huh..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I never imagined... I'd receive a letter like this.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...That girl, she was trembling when she handed it over.
Mustering up her courage to express her gratitude, was she?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh! I'll keep this up.
So the children can feel safe and secure...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, Fenomeno was so overwhelmed with emotion
that she couldn't fall asleep.
